title: pm-dispatch filing-gate: metadata-protocol changes and REST/data-door narrowings grade p1 in every lane; ceiling 58 → 61 by ruling
body:
Part of #23431 — this PR lands the protocol-first grading rule the maintainer ordered, under the ceiling raise the maintainer ruled. It leaves open the second half of the maintainer's scope amendment on the card (comment 6164667370): the consumer-follow-up principle (options A + C, 「同意 A + C」), which needs three lines more than the ruled ceiling funds (Acceptance notes). The card stays open for that half.

Clause-②: no

## What changes

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md`, section 〈定级判据(北极星「优先级」的执行说明)〉: four rule lines (N1–N4) open the section; old L41 is deleted as a restatement. 58 → 61 lines. Old L36 and L43 are untouched; N3's sentence 「维护者裁决,本节余条不压」 makes every other line of the section, those two included, subordinate to the rule. Nothing outside this section moves.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the `CEILINGS` row for that file, 58 → 61, with the ruling recorded beside it. No other row and no logic changes.

## The rulings, verbatim

- The order (filing gate ③, quoted on the card): 「spec 车道待办任务中，哪些是会导致元数据协议变更的，这一类应该提高优先级」 · 「我的意思是元数据的协议变更应该优先处理，避免每个版本应用都要做复杂的升级」 · 「协议变更还经常会影响 objectui 项目的开发，相关任务经常等 spec 发版本」 · 「所有元数据协议变更一律 p1，是否建议修改分诊skills」 · 「立卡，规则扩到所有车道，REST 收窄也算」
- The ceiling raise. The ratchet header requires the maintainer's ruling quoted in the raising PR: 「23431 同意。」 (maintainer, live chat, 2026-10-14), adopting letter B of the seat analysis (comment 6164664770). Ruling record: comment 6164802336 on the card.
- The scope amendment (comment 6164667370, triage seat), item 1, applied here: 「原则不要写具体的版本号，比如后面我们要开发 v19的时候还得改原则」. N3 names the `target:` label of the major in development, not a version; N1–N4 carry no version number (`next.N` is the prerelease pattern, not a release).

It is the only restatement in the section: L39 and L44–L45 each carry their own item of that commit, and the rest are pointer targets (`triage-duties.md` L59 points here).

Added at the head of the section, new L36–L39 (bytes against the 120-byte cap):

(116 / 120 / 120 / 95 B.) Content map to the card's "What done looks like": the class (spec accept/declare face, ADR-0087 conversion windows included; the `/meta` read/save/delete door's accept and answer; widening or narrowing) is N1, with 「任何车道」 in N3; the REST/data-door narrowing and the exclusions are N2; the grade (p1 plus the major-in-development `target:` label; conditional cards alike) and the subordination are N3; the release side is N4. The card's parenthetical enumeration (schemas, stack and manifest definitions, hook and flow contracts) is folded into "what spec declares". Bare `p1` follows the section's own house style for `p3`. Measured floor: four lines. No three-line spelling fits the cap (122–148 B on at least one line).

- 可达面定上界:`security` 标签不抬级;仅最高权限可达且无现用者至多 p3,可记录不修。

## Acceptance notes

- **The open half: the consumer-follow-up principle (amendment item 2, options A + C).** The amendment places it in this same rule. Measured drafts, three lines at their tightest (107 / 103 / 102 B): a consumer's follow-up card (objectui types mirror, renderers, Studio) is p1 only when its absence breaks users; "breaks users" means the designer systematically writes metadata the protocol refuses, or a declared block or key renders nothing; every follow-up is listed on the consumer's first-release card for the new major. That needs the ceiling at 64, three more than ruled, or another home. The seat decides. If the seat carries it on another card, change line 1 of this body to the closing form.
- Other texts that can still cap this class, outside this card's surface; noted, not filed (carrier: `domain:skills` seat):
  - `triage-duties.md` L90–L92: the `target:` criterion is binary, with four blocking classes that a protocol widening does not meet.
  - `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 〈阶段姿态〉 「兼容层、迁移窗口一类的工作默认 p3」: conflicts with ADR-0087 windows being in the class.
  - `triage-duties.md` L58/L60 「无则关」: closes at first touch a card with no North Star definition item.
  - `SKILL.md` L213: a dispatch cap on the top-privilege-only shape.
  - N3's 「本节余条不压」 reaches only this section. `SKILL.md` 〈优先级〉 (维护者裁决 above 细则) answers the rest only in principle.
